mapper.insert: insert into lib_loans ( loan_id, book_id, userid, loan_date, return_date ) values ( #{loanId}, #{bookId}, #{userid}, #{loanDate}, #{returnDate} )
mapper.select: select row_number() OVER (ORDER BY loan_id DESC) AS idx, COALESCE((SELECT f.bk_file_ori_name FROM lib_file_book f WHERE b.book_id = f.book_id), '') AS file_name, loan_id, l.book_id, title, author, publisher, cheonggu, userid, loan_date, return_date, due_date, loan_state from lib_loans l inner join lib_books b on b.book_id = l.book_id where loan_state = 'Y' and l.userid = #{userid} limit #{recordCountPerPage} offset #{firstIndex}
select count(*) from lib_loans where loan_state = 'Y' and userid = #{userid}

select r.userid, r.book_id, title, author, email, to_char(resv_date,'HH:MI:SS') as resv_time from lib_resv r inner join lib_member m on r.userid = m.userid inner join lib_books b on r.book_id = b.book_id where r.book_id = ( SELECT book_id FROM lib_loans WHERE loan_id = #{loanId} ) order by resv_time limit 1
SELECT ((#{returnDate} - loan_date) - due_date) as due_count, CASE WHEN (#{returnDate} - loan_date) > due_date THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS overdue_state FROM lib_loans ll WHERE loan_id = #{loanId}

select row_number() OVER (ORDER BY loan_id DESC) AS idx, COALESCE((SELECT f.bk_file_ori_name FROM lib_file_book f WHERE b.book_id = f.book_id), '') AS file_name, loan_id, l.book_id, title, author, publisher, cheonggu, userid, loan_date, return_date, loan_state from lib_loans l inner join lib_books b on b.book_id = l.book_id where loan_state = 'N' and userid = #{userid} limit #{recordCountPerPage} offset #{firstIndex}
select count(*) from lib_loans l where loan_state = 'N' and userid = #{userid}

SELECT o.due_count - (current_date - o.return_date) as due_count, CASE WHEN o.due_count > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS overdue_state FROM ( SELECT return_date, (return_date - loan_date) - due_date AS due_count FROM lib_loans WHERE userid = #{userid} AND loan_state = 'N' ) AS o ORDER BY o.due_count - (current_date - o.return_date) DESC LIMIT 1
select count(book_id) from lib_loans l where userid = #{userid} and loan_state = 'Y'
